We need to count methyl groups in the molecule. But we don't have the molecule given. Possibly the sample is implicit? Maybe we need to retrieve NMR spectra to infer methyl groups. Could use proton NMR to see methyl signals. But we need the molecule structure. No SMILES provided. Could be that the system expects us to call carbon_nmr_spectra or proton_nmr_spectra to get data, then infer number of methyl groups.

We can request proton NMR spectra. That will give peaks, including methyl singlets around 0.9 ppm. But counting methyl groups from NMR may be ambiguous. However likely the molecule is known to the system; the tool will return spectra for "sample at hand". So we can call proton_nmr_spectra (no args). Then analyze peaks: count distinct methyl signals? Might be multiple methyl groups overlapping. Could also use carbon NMR: methyl carbons around 10-30 ppm. Counting distinct methyl carbon signals.

Simplify: call proton_nmr_spectra.
